key_insight: A zero-cost Google-based digital workflow can substantially scale assessment and reduce educator workload in a multi-center mechanical ventilation curriculum.
clinical_relevance: This approach may help training programs deliver more consistent feedback and assessment at larger scale without needing extra licensing or IT support.
method: Built a standardized portfolio tracking system with automated reminders for milestone completion.
Compared fall portfolio completion before vs after automation (Fall 2024 manual vs Fall 2025 automated).
Implemented an automatically graded multiple-choice case-based waveform exam with expert-defined partial-credit scoring.
evidence_signal: Compared with manual processes, portfolio submissions increased from 45.6% to 68.5%, required waveform completion improved from 29.0% to 55.6% among submitters, and automated grading saved 8.5 hours per grader per cycle while matching scoring expectations.
watch_item: Results come from a program-specific proof-of-concept, so broader adoption will still need validation across different curricula, institutions, and learner groups.
paper_title: Zero-Cost Digital Automation for Scalable Assessment in a National Mechanical Ventilation Curriculum
